wholePhysicalScope: The two surveyed inner rings and historic illustrated plan identify the chapel and garden ranges, cross-range and courtyard ranges. Current photograph establishes the east garden-facing upper range.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the two courts, the gate tower, chapel and Long Gallery.
limitations: The existing manor and attached chapel. Surrounding garden walls, gatehouse at the road, stables and interior spaces are outside scope.
Current published plans do not give all parapet heights and upper roofs; those are estimated from listing and imagery.
